summary: Iteration 158 — Backend + Frontend validation of 6 P0 pre-launch fixes (Google OAuth/Profile settings, AI chatbot fallback, InfoTip tap-to-toggle, image compression, Farm->Heavy Equipment migration, Hero stat-card removal). Backend: 9/10 passed + 1 skipped (listing-creation-via-API blocked by trust-status/payment-method guard — covered by direct unit test of compress_data_url which passes). Frontend: homepage hero has NO 50K+/10K+/$2M+/99.9% cards; /settings shows Email + 'Change Email' button + Province dropdown (13 provinces/territories + placeholder = 14 options); Google Login button redirects to https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=…/marketplace; Buyer dashboard has 6 InfoTips (requirement 5+); Seller dashboard has 5 InfoTips with commission rate text (requirement 5+); AI FAB chat widget is visible in DOM bottom-right.

P3: NotificationListener WS error on every page — pre-existing, out of iter158 scope.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/auth.py email-change flow is clean: password verified with verify_password, same-email check, uniqueness check at BOTH request-time and confirm-time (prevents TOCTOU email hijack), 24h token expiry, sessions invalidated on confirm — Law 25 compliant. SendGrid failure is swallowed (log-only) so request succeeds even if email provider is down — UX trade-off; consider returning 202 if email send fails so the UI can show 'email may not have arrived'. Currently a silent partial success.

services/image_compression.py compress_data_url correctly handles PNG→JPEG, RGBA/LA/P alpha→white background, EXIF auto-orient, strip metadata, 800px longest-side cap. Measured 238KB PNG → ~13KB JPEG at 800x600 in unit test (94% reduction). Falls back to original on any exception which is the right behavior.

ProfileSettingsPage Province dropdown renders 13 provinces/territories + placeholder (14 options) bilingual (e.g. 'Québec', 'British Columbia / Colombie-Britannique'). PUT /api/users/me persists province=QC verified via /api/auth/me roundtrip.
Homepage hero cleanly removed stat cards block — verified by body-text search for '50K+','10K+','$2M+','99.9%' — none present.
Categories migration complete: GET /api/categories returns 'Heavy Equipment' and NO 'Farm Equipment' in any slug, name, name_en, or name_fr (including all subcategory children walked recursively).
AuthPage handleGoogleLogin → redirects to https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fprod-verify-2.preview.emergentagent.com%2Fmarketplace — confirmed via Playwright request interceptor.
Buyer and Seller dashboards have 6 and 5 [data-testid^='infotip'] elements respectively — meeting the '5+ each' requirement. Seller dashboard shows 'Seller Commission: 2%' text alongside InfoTip.
